item.text:
Implemented the SQLite-backed job tracker across [db.ts](/opt/harness/work/.runs/campaign/cohort-03/block-10/slot-07-irf.CC-AF-CC.on/attempt-1/workspace/src/db.ts), [server.ts](/opt/harness/work/.runs/campaign/cohort-03/block-10/slot-07-irf.CC-AF-CC.on/attempt-1/workspace/src/server.ts), [worker.ts](/opt/harness/work/.runs/campaign/cohort-03/block-10/slot-07-irf.CC-AF-CC.on/attempt-1/workspace/src/worker.ts), and [index.html](/opt/harness/work/.runs/campaign/cohort-03/block-10/slot-07-irf.CC-AF-CC.on/attempt-1/workspace/ui/index.html). It includes validation, durable idempotency, retries and crash recovery, worker health tracking, and a polling browser UI.

`npm run build` passes, and the worker started and processed a job in a local database. The smoke and contract checks, and a direct server startup, could not run here because the environment rejects socket binding with `listen EPERM`.
